options.markdown:
Azure VM Scale Sets logs

These charts refer to the Activity logs. To configure Activity logs follow this documentation and to configure the logs on Splunk Enterprise/Cloud follow this Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Documentation. For more information on sending logs to Splunk Log Observer Connect, see Log Observer Connect documentation.
